text: In crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md, the instruction to cite the fmt, clippy and test results under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' does not say where: job 20261024-033935-c4w4's verifier quoted them in its evidence text with an empty commands list, and D43 (verify.rs) reads only the commands list, so the criterion was rejected. Say that each recorded check cited goes in that criterion's commands list exactly as shown under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'. Keep the change verifier inside its token budget (cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture prints the sizes) and edit only that prompt and CHANGELOG.md.
